mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_runtime_desktop_verified_identities(tenant_id,reference,session_id,target_kind,target_id,end_user_id,policy_revision) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{reference},#{sessionId},#{targetKind},#{targetId},#{endUserId},#{policyRevision}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,reference,session_id,target_kind,target_id,end_user_id,policy_revision FROM agent_runtime_desktop_verified_identities WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reference=#{reference}
SELECT scope FROM agent_runtime_desktop_identity_scopes WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reference=#{reference} ORDER BY scope
